hotels.title: Sophisticated Munich City Stay by Pullman near the English Garden
hotels.description: In Munich’s refined Schwabing district, this contemporary retreat places you near the English Garden’s leafy paths and the boutiques, galleries and cafés of Leopoldstrasse. Marienplatz, the Residenz and the Pinakothek museums are easily reached by nearby public transport. Inside, sleek rooms and suites are paired with a tranquil spa, indoor pool and a leafy courtyard terrace. Evenings can be spent over modern Bavarian plates at Theos Restaurant or with a crafted drink in the hotel’s polished bar and lounge
